description:
Use this when the user wants their brand kit set up or changed: "use this logo for my brand", "my brand colors
        are red and white", "my brand font is Montserrat", "take that old logo out of my kit". logo_url: a link to a
        picture (an https link to a .jpg, .png or .webp, or a Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive share link open to
        anyone), added as a brand logo; the picture is checked and kept in RipClip. remove_logos: logo_id values from
        get_brand_kit to take out of the kit. colors: the full list of up to 8 brand colors (names like red or hex like
        #FFE600); it replaces the old list and an empty list clears it. fonts: the full list of up to 8 font names from
        edit_catalog(kind="fonts"), same rules. Anything left out stays as it was, including the intro, outro and music.
        This is a Premium feature: it is refused on the free plan before anything changes. Never reads a file from the
        user's computer.
        Not for: putting the kit on clips (apply_brand_kit) or a one-off caption color or font (style_clip). Costs no
        Horizon Units. Next: apply_brand_kit.
name: set_brand_kit
title: Change the brand kit
